condition: Corner buildings, or buildings fronting a side street off Parramatta Road, that adjoin a heritage conservation area (Parramatta Road Enterprise Corridor)
source_text:
Parramatta Road, that adjoin a heritage conservation area
are to be setback 3m from the secondary street (or side
street off Parramatta Road) to provide a transition to the
front setbacks of the adjoining conservation area.
_dev_type_evidence: Chapter D precinct guidelines, Parramatta Road Enterprise Corridor.

condition: Corner lot, secondary boundary setback, dwellings and dual occupancies (general table control)
_dev_type_evidence: The table's own heading on page 9: 'Table 3.1.2-a: Minimum boundary setbacks for dwellings and dual occupancies'.

condition: Corner lot, detached dual occupancy - the dwelling fronting the primary road must be setback from the secondary road boundary
source_text:
The dwelling fronting the main Primary Road
should have a minimum setback with the
secondary road of 3m (see Figure 3.1-g).
_dev_type_evidence: Page 9 prescriptive measure (h): 'An attached dual occupancy on a corner lot should have both dwellings address the primary road frontage'. The clause's subject is dual occupancy.

condition: Corner lot, secondary frontage adjoining an existing laneway with no verge - building setback
source_text:
Where a secondary frontage adjoins an existing
laneway (with no verge), all buildings and
structures should be setback a minimum of 6
metres from the boundary.
_dev_type_evidence: Our own extracted provisions give the part title: '3.4 Residential Flat Buildings (5 Storeys)' (ref Hornsby_DCP_2024__hornsby_dcp_2024_part3_residential__3_4). Section 3.4.5 is its setbacks sub-section.

condition: Multi dwelling housing, corner lot, secondary building line; standard 6m front setback reducible at Council's discretion to 4.5m
_dev_type_evidence: Part 4 residential, multi dwelling housing. Confirmed by our own table: marrickville already holds multi_dwelling_housing front_setback 6.0m at section_ref 's4.2.4.3-C11(i)' -- the same clause.

condition: Commercial/mixed use development, corner property located on the corner of two major streets - upper-level massing setback required to both frontages (primary and secondary)
source_text:
Upper levels above the street front portion of the building mass must be
setback a minimum 6 metres from the street front of the building
(required to both frontages when the site is located on the corner of two
major streets), except for 0.9 metres roof projection of the topmost
dwelling occupancy level.
_dev_type_evidence: Part 5 'General Commercial and Mixed Use Development Controls'.

condition: Commercial/mixed use development, corner property with secondary frontage to a minor street or laneway - upper-level massing setback above the street front portion of the building (excludes a 0.9m roof projection for the topmost dwelling occupancy level)
source_text:
On corner properties where the secondary frontage is to a minor street
or laneway, the upper levels above the street front portion of the building
mass facing the secondary frontage must be setback a minimum 3
metres from the secondary street frontage of the building, except for 0.9
metres roof projection of the topmost dwelling occupancy level.
_dev_type_evidence: Part 5 'General Commercial and Mixed Use Development Controls'.
